name.en: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi (income support for farmer families)

summary.en: Rs.6,000 per year per farmer family, paid in three instalments of Rs.2,000 every four months by direct bank transfer

name.en: Bank account details (bank e-KYC is mandatory)
Land ownership details as recorded in the State land records

en: Visit the PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or your nearest Common Service Centre.
Choose New Farmer Registration and enter Aadhaar number, mobile number and state.
Fill in personal, bank and land details as per official records.
Complete e-KYC. You can check your status on the portal's Know Your Status page.

to_confirm: Excluded: institutional landholders, families with holders of constitutional posts, serving or retired officials (except multi-tasking/Class IV/Group D staff), pensioners with Rs.10,000 or more per month, income tax payers, and registered professionals such as doctors, engineers and lawyers
Land bought after 01-02-2019 and more than one family member claiming can cause payments to be held for verification
The State or UT government identifies eligible families, so check with your local agriculture office
